title: This Animal Survived Being Launched Into Space
description:
In 2007, scientists exposed a tiny animal to the vacuum of space with no protection at all, on purpose. Most of them lived.

#shorts #sciencefacts #space

scenes.text: In 2007, scientists launched a creature into space with basically no protection, on purpose.
It's called a tardigrade, or water bear, less than a millimeter long.
They opened a capsule in orbit and exposed the tardigrades directly to the vacuum of space.
No air, no pressure, and unfiltered solar radiation, for ten days straight.
When the capsule came back to Earth, most of them were still alive.
Some even went on to reproduce normally afterward.
Scientists still don't fully understand how a multicellular animal survives that.
